calculation.description: Rank tradable instruments by the negative of their trailing two-session return. Higher values indicate recent relative weakness and a cross-sectional rebound opportunity. Inputs are lagged through the prior completed session.

validation.regime_notes: Early 2020-2022: IC +0.043494, ICIR +0.125046, 305 observations; middle 2023-2025: IC +0.058885, ICIR +0.161510, 301; late 2026-2027: IC +0.021535, ICIR +0.064414, 231. The late subperiod is weaker, so monitor drift. Small 15-asset universe implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
